quirks.reference_behavior: The Polaris 0.6.0 snapshot declares application/pdf as the produced media type.
quirks.observed_behavior: The device returned HTTP 406 when the client sent Accept: application/json and succeeded with Accept: application/pdf.
quirks.compatibility_behavior: Send endpoint-specific Accept headers: application/json for JSON operations and application/pdf for PDF download.
quirks.fallback: No fallback is required because the compatibility behavior is also specification-conformant.

quirks.reference_behavior: Modern TLS hostname verification requires a Subject Alternative Name extension; Common Name alone is insufficient.
quirks.observed_behavior: The self-signed device certificate has CN=digitalpaper.local and no certificate extensions, including no Subject Alternative Name.
quirks.compatibility_behavior: Retain the registration-returned certificate and pin its exact leaf DER SHA-256; do not disable verification or rely on legacy Common Name matching.
quirks.fallback: Profiles with an explicit exact fingerprint use certificate pinning. CA-only profiles continue to use normal chain and hostname verification.
